title: Republic of Ireland confirm rescheduled news conference before controversial Israel game
summary_full: The Republic of Ireland will now hold their delayed news conference at 14:30 BST before they face Israel in tomorrow's Nations League fixture in Hungary - a fixture campaigners have called on them to boycott.
